Name: Elkanah, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Son of Jeroham in the Samuel line, ancestor of Samuel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:27: Son of Jeroham in the Samuel line, ancestor of Samuel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elkanah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
